Language.label: Language
Language.switchAria: التبديل إلى العربية — Switch to Arabic

Admin.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
Admin.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
Admin.emailTaken: A user with this e-mail already exists.
Admin.name: Name
Admin.tempPasswordHelp: At least 12 characters. Give it to the user privately and ask them to change it.
Admin.confirmDisable: Disable this user? They will be signed out immediately.
Admin.resetDone: Password updated. The user's sessions were signed out.
Admin.notSelf: You cannot disable or demote your own account here.
Admin.lastAdmin: At least one active admin is required.
Admin.cdpRawLabel: Allow original comments and thanks & recognition names in the CDP results
Admin.cdpRawHelp: Without it the user sees aggregated results and comments with identifying details removed only. Admins always have it.
Admin.usersIntro: Admins upload data files, manage users and see original data. Viewers (management) see aggregated results only; grant “CDP original data” to let a viewer read original comments and names.

Cdp.pageIntro: Results calculated from the actual responses in the survey file. Choose a department to update every question.
Cdp.noDataAdmin: Upload the responses Excel file, review the validation report, then publish it.
Cdp.noDataViewer: Results will appear here once an administrator publishes the responses file.
Cdp.missingSummary: Columns not found in the current file: {list}. Those question cards show a notice instead of results.
Cdp.totalNote: All responses in the current file; it does not change with the department filter.
Cdp.deptTitle: Participants by department or operational area
Cdp.deptNote: Responses and share of all responses received. Click a department to see its results.
Cdp.clickToFilter: Click to show this department's results
Cdp.smallDept: Fewer than {n} responses — included in overall results only
Cdp.smallDeptNote: For privacy, departments with fewer than {n} responses are counted in the overall results; their results and comments are not shown separately.
Cdp.missingColumn: This question's column was not found in the uploaded file.
Cdp.noAnswers: No answers to this question in the current view.
Cdp.thanksNote: Covers contributions of Omantel staff and the Huawei OMS team.
Cdp.thanksNames: Names of the people who provided support
Cdp.originalWarning: Original text — visible to you only because you are authorised. Do not show it in meetings.
Cdp.namesRestricted: Answers: {n}. Names are visible to authorised users only.
Cdp.challengeNote: Here “Yes” means the participant faced a challenge. Not combined with satisfaction questions.
Cdp.themesNote: {classified} of {total} comments are classified. One comment can carry several themes, so theme counts can add up to more than the number of comments.
Cdp.reportPrivacy: Aggregated results; identifying details removed from comments; no respondent names or employee numbers
Cdp.adminIntro: Upload the survey responses Excel file. Sheet1 is read and validated first; the current results stay on screen until you publish the new file. Respondent name, e-mail and employee number columns are dropped while reading and never stored, and the original file is not kept.
Cdp.uploadTooLarge: The file is larger than allowed.
Cdp.uploadNotXlsx: The file is not a valid Excel (.xlsx) workbook.
Cdp.uploadNoSheet: No worksheet found in the file.
Cdp.uploadHasErrors: Validated — errors were found that prevent publishing. See the report below.
Cdp.uploadValidated: Validated. Review the report, then press “Publish”.
Cdp.cannotActivate: A file with errors cannot be published.
Cdp.activated: Published. The results now use this file.
Cdp.cannotDeleteActive: The published file cannot be deleted.
Cdp.issue_noDepartment: The department / operational area column is missing.
Cdp.issue_blankDepartment: {count} responses have no department; they appear under “—”.
Cdp.issue_matchedByPosition: Question {id} was matched by column position because its header text did not match. Please check it.
Cdp.issue_columnMoved: Question {id} was found in column {column} instead of the expected column.
Cdp.issue_noSatisfaction: None of the four satisfaction questions was found.
Cdp.issue_unknownValues: {count} answers are not “Yes / To some extent / No”; counted separately.
Cdp.reportSummary: Sheet: {sheet} · header row: {row} · responses: {rows} · department column: {dept}
Cdp.referenceMismatch: Some counts differ from the reference — please review.
Cdp.referenceNA: The number of responses differs from the reference file, so differences are expected (for information only).
Cdp.confirmActivate: Publish this file? It replaces the results currently shown.
Cdp.confirmDelete: Remove this file from the platform?
Cdp.peopleNote: Omantel and Huawei OMS staff named by participants, ranked by how many participants named each person. Different spellings of the same name (Arabic/English) are grouped automatically.
Cdp.peopleSummary: {people} people were named; {repeated} of them by more than one participant.
Cdp.peopleVisibility: Names are visible to authorised users only.
Cdp.peopleRestricted: Names are visible to authorised users only.
Cdp.thanksRestricted: Answers: {n}. Thanks messages contain names, so they are shown to authorised users only.
Cdp.boardIntro: Thank you to everyone who helped and supported their colleagues on their development journey during the CDP 2026 programme — from Omantel and the Huawei OMS team.
Cdp.boardBasis: Based on what {n} participants wrote in the programme evaluation
Cdp.boardFeaturedNote: People named by more than one participant as supporting their development.
Cdp.boardPublish: Publish the board to all platform users
Cdp.boardUnpublish: Hide the board from non-authorised users
Cdp.boardConfirmPublish: Publish the thanks board to every platform user? Names will be visible to management too.
Cdp.boardNotPublished: The thanks board has not been published yet.
